softwareValidation.note: Automated WebKit/iPhone evidence is not physical-device acceptance. This green runtime includes the complete trainer-library reconciliation, visible Canvassing Library, offline Canvassing Library acceptance, current opener-authority treatment, and current 2026 Missing Parties behavior while preserving the controlled field baseline.

missingParties.definition: One or more homeowners or decision makers are not present for the appointment.
missingParties.note: Supports appointment QA and Missing Parties coaching; does not create a blanket spouse-must-be-present rule.

openingWording.candidate: I'm not here to sell you anything. I'm [Name] with Paradise Exteriors. We're doing some work here in the neighborhood. Quick question—have you ever gotten an estimate to replace your [windows / doors / roof]?
openingWording.userDirection: Preserve the existing candidate wording; do not rewrite it during unrelated curriculum/library work.
openingWording.paradisePrecedent: May 23, 2025 internal Canvass Training Manual contains the same core I'm not here to sell you anything phrase.
openingWording.fieldInstructionUntilDecision: Use only the current manager-approved canvass opening in the field.
openingWording.requiredEvidence: Completed docs/PARADISE_UNIVERSITY_HUMAN_CURRENTNESS_DECISION.md choosing APPROVE or REVISE for the exact candidate.

canvassingLibrary.authorityRule: Trainer items remain REFERENCE/HISTORICAL as applicable and do not become Paradise Approved because they are visible or playable.

curatedTargetAudit.tonySet: 5/5 original curated Tony targets resolved: 5 audio/mpeg, all nonzero

curatedTargetAudit.note: This target audit establishes that the original curated catalog is not pointing at missing Drive objects and that every retrievable curated file is structurally decodable. It does not substitute for real Safari/PWA playback.

postReconciliationTonyIntegrityCheck.note: Direct Drive retrieval and full local decode prove file integrity for the recommended Tony physical-test pair. They do not prove Drive iframe playback in physical iPhone Safari/PWA.

internalTrainerMedia.scope: Paradise employee/internal training only; preserve REFERENCE/HISTORICAL authority labels and do not treat trainer media as current Paradise policy.
internalTrainerMedia.note: Internal-use treatment is a project operating choice, not a legal opinion. Media-rights documentation is not a Paradise University release gate under the current project scope.

physicalDeviceAcceptance.requiredEvidence: Named human physical test on an actual iPhone in Safari and installed Home Screen PWA, including field regression, 24/24 Tony Canvassing Library visibility, both Tony manuals, offline metadata/library behavior, and actual Tony audio/video playback.

humanCurriculumComplianceReview.currentnessDecision: OPEN — exact canvass opener requires named human APPROVE or REVISE decision; Missing Parties currentness is already closed from current 2026 policy.
humanCurriculumComplianceReview.requiredEvidence: Completed currentness decision plus named human reviewer, date, exact candidate commit, and disposition covering curriculum accuracy, complete Tony/Yoho/Grosso library presentation, Paradise policy boundaries, field-authority separation, sales procedure holds, tone, and usability.

promotionAuthorization.requiredEvidence: Explicit authorization to advance the validated branch after all other gates are PASS.

validatedBranchReadback.requiredEvidence: After authorized promotion, read back validated branch commit, dataset SHA, 78/76/2 guards, and operational URL behavior before calling the release live.

hardRule: A green software validator is necessary but not sufficient for release. Current blockers are the named human opener-currentness decision within the broader human curriculum/compliance sign-off, physical-device acceptance, and explicit promotion authorization. Missing Parties currentness is source-supported and closed; the complete trainer-library software/catalog reconciliation is PASS; internal trainer-media rights are not a release blocker under the current project scope.
